drhp.business: AVSL Industries is a manufacturing organization producing raw materials for the power cable and telecom cable industry and some material for the irrigation industry, including PVC Compound, HDPE/LDPE Compound, PVC Filler, HDPE/LDPE Tape, PVC tape, Polyester Tape, Aluminum Mylar tape and marking tapes.
